summary: Tech dragged the whole market down. The Nasdaq lost the trailing stop it had just reclaimed, closing the day session near 28,038, off about 1.2% after a flush to 27,690. The S&P gave back 0.4% and lost its stop at 7,607. The damage was concentrated in chips after a Nvidia leadership shock, so the Nasdaq fell about three times as much as the S&P, while gold and crude sat flat. Buyers clawed back roughly half the drop late. October PPI was tame on the month but the yearly rate hit a three-year high, and the market now prices a likely December rate hike.

event.actual: PPI plus 0.3% m/m (below consensus); plus 6.5% y/y, highest since November 2022; core plus 0.3% m/m, plus 5.0% y/y
event.surprise: The monthly number came in tame, but the yearly rate firmed to a three-year high and the market moved to price about 100% odds of a December rate hike, with the 10-year near 5.13%.

event.crossAsset: Tech led down after a Nvidia leadership shock (the Nasdaq fell about three times the S&P); gold flat (+0.06%), crude flat (-0.02%); VIX spiked to 20.92 then settled at 18.94.

risk.sizing: Size down. The long posture is gone: MNQ 28,236 and MES 7,607 are now overhead resistance, so longs wait for a reclaim. December gold stays a short below 3,919; crude is the lone long above 87.70.
risk.openRisk: Both equity boards closed below their stops; only crude holds a long. Do not carry oversized risk into Nvidia earnings Tuesday or the December FOMC.
risk.note: Stepped down to REDUCED from NORMAL because both equity boards lost their trailing stops and closed below them, and volatility ticked up (VIX tagged 20.92 before settling 18.94). Hold-above longs are gone: MNQ 28,236 and MES 7,607 are now overhead; December gold stays a short below 3,919; crude is the lone long above 87.70. Size down into Nvidia earnings Tuesday Nov 17 and a December FOMC the market now reads as a likely hike. Week ahead: Nvidia earnings Tuesday; December FOMC the next policy event.

psychology: Days like this punish stubbornness. If you were long into the open because the overnight tape looked strong, the job was to respect the stop the moment price lost it rather than argue with it. The Nasdaq closing its hourly bars below the 28,236 trailing line was the tell, and it came early. Averaging down into a leader like Nvidia while it is breaking is how a small loss becomes an account event. The flip side matters too: the late bounce off 27,690 was a gift for anyone who had already cut and was waiting to re-enter with a plan. Let the level decide. Below the stop you stand aside or lean short; above it you can lean long again.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band Reversal (MNQ)
fullReport.html: MNQ: session VWAP 27,931; 2-sigma 28,113 / 27,750; 3-sigma 28,204 / 27,659. The session low printed 27,690.50, within about 30 points of the lower 3-sigma band, then reverted hard to close 28,038 back above VWAP. The stretched tag and snap-back was the reversion long off the lows; the close back above VWAP is where dip-buyers took control into the bell.
